Scaffold a provider package's KB sources

Source: R/mcp_provider_kb.R
scaffold_provider_kb.Rd

Creates inst/mcp/kb/sources/ with a format README and a starter source file in a provider package source tree, so the provider can author cited markdown and run generate_certara_kb() to ship its own discoverable KB slice.

Usage

scaffold_provider_kb(pkg_root, package, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

pkg_root

Path to the provider package source root.

package

Provider package name (stamped on entries).

overwrite

Overwrite an existing starter file.

Value

Invisibly the sources directory path.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
scaffold_provider_kb(pkg_root = ".", package = "tidyvpc")
} # }
